pages.title: Bramble Bind
pages.text: Hurls a thorned vine seed. The seed roots itself and waits; when something hostile steps into its 3x3 ground, brambles erupt and bind it fast for 5 seconds. The trap lingers until its ten seconds run out, and anything else that wanders in gets caught too - unable to move, use items or cast, bosses included. The red thorns bite for 2 damage every second.

pages.title: Gifts of the Wilds
pages.text: Cast with a Wild Staff, the ground widens to 7x7, the bind lasts 15 seconds, and up to 16 targets can be caught at once. Wearing a Wild Robe widens it further to 9x9 (the robe overrides the staff), and the thorns begin to weep poison.

pages.title: Vine Poison
pages.text: With a Wild Robe, bound targets are poisoned for as long as they stay bound. It strikes once a second and grows harsher each time, ignoring armour, resistances, enchantments and invulnerability frames, and no healing can touch the victim while it lasts - the undead and even effect-immune bosses bleed under it. Fifteen seconds of this ends most things.
